title: Peach and Raspberry Ice Cream Cake
changes_from_base: A thin vanilla sponge cut into strips and layered in a loaf tin with a no-churn peach ice cream and mashed raspberries, instead of chocolate sponge and two ice creams.
summary: Thin layers of sponge are stacked with peach and raspberry ripple cream, then frozen into a loaf and finished with a pile of fresh peach and raspberry on top.

ingredients.item: fine sea salt or table salt
fine sea salt or table salt
unsalted butter, soft, plus extra for the tin
large egg yolk, at room temperature

steps.title: Macerate
steps.text: Toss the 170 g chopped peach with 1 tbsp caster sugar in one bowl and the 240 g raspberries with the other 1 tbsp caster sugar in another, then leave both to stand for at least 1 h.

steps.title: Whisk
steps.text: Whisk the 95 g plain flour with ¾ tsp baking powder and ¼ tsp fine salt in one bowl, then beat the 70 g soft butter with 100 g caster sugar until fluffy, about 3 min.

steps.title: Batter
steps.text: Beat in ½ tsp vanilla and the egg and egg yolk, then fold in the flour mixture alternately with the 2 tbsp whole milk.

steps.title: Bake
steps.text: Spread the batter thinly in the lined, buttered large tin and bake at 180 °C for 10-12 min until golden and springy, then cool for 10 min before turning out and peeling off the paper.

steps.title: Cream
steps.text: Mix the 154 g chopped peach jam, 120 ml evaporated milk, a pinch of salt and the macerated peaches with their juice, then whip the 360 ml double cream to stiff peaks and fold through.

steps.title: Cut
steps.text: Trim the sponge into 3 strips about 23 x 11 cm, leaving a 6 mm gap all round once placed in the film-lined loaf tin.

steps.title: Layer
steps.text: Build the cake with a third of the cream, a sponge strip pressed down so the cream rises around it, and half the drained raspberries, then repeat and finish with the last of the cream and the final sponge strip.

steps.title: Freeze
steps.text: Wrap well and freeze for at least 8 h.

steps.title: Serve
steps.text: Toss the sliced peach and 60 g raspberries with 1 tbsp caster sugar for 10 min, then invert the cake, let it stand for 5-10 min and pile the fruit on top.

tips: Let the peaches and raspberries macerate for at least 1 h so their juices flavour the cream.
Trim the sponge strips carefully so a small gap remains for the cream to rise around them.
Let the frozen cake stand for 5-10 min once turned out so it is easy to slice.
safety: Don't taste the raw dough or batter: raw flour and raw egg aren't safe to eat until baked.
storage: Keep the cake well wrapped in the freezer and add the sugared fruit only when serving.
